info.short_name: COVID-19 Cases, Season to Date (VHA)
info.long_name: Cumulative lab-confirmed COVID-19 cases among VA patients since the start of the respiratory season
info.short_description: Season-to-date count of lab-confirmed COVID-19 cases reported by the Veterans Health Administration.
info.long_description: Cumulative number of laboratory-confirmed COVID-19 cases among patients of the Veterans Health Administration since the start of the respiratory season (seasons run October 1 to September 30), from the VHA Seasonal Disease Review via the CMU Delphi Epidata API. Delphi publishes this series daily; PopHIVE keeps the value reported for each week-ending Saturday. The count resets at the start of each season; in 2026 the reset was delayed past October 1, so early-October values may still include the previous season. Cumulative counts can fall when VHA revises earlier reports. VHA censors counts under 11 upstream and reports them as 5, so some values may include this placeholder; it cannot be reliably identified in case counts (state values of 1-10 other than 5 also occur), so case counts are not flagged. National totals are withheld by Delphi on any day a state is missing, so the national series is often unavailable. Veterans enrolled in VA health care are mostly older and male, so values may not reflect transmission in the wider community.
info.statement: In {location}, VHA reported {value} lab-confirmed COVID-19 cases so far this season.

info.short_name: COVID-19 Case Rate, 7-Day Average (VHA)
info.long_name: New lab-confirmed COVID-19 cases per 100,000 enrolled veterans, 7-day trailing average
info.short_description: Average daily new COVID-19 cases per 100,000 enrolled veterans over the week.
info.long_description: Average daily number of newly reported laboratory-confirmed COVID-19 cases per 100,000 veterans enrolled in VA health care, over the 7 days ending on the week-ending Saturday (that is, the Sunday-Saturday MMWR week), computed by the CMU Delphi Group from day-to-day changes in VHA's cumulative counts. Enrollee counts from the VHA Enrollees by County dataset are the denominator; state values are native, and the national value is an enrollee-weighted average of states. Delphi publishes this series daily; PopHIVE keeps the value reported for each week-ending Saturday. Because new cases are derived from changes in a cumulative count, downward revisions can produce negative values; these are set to missing. Rates around the season reset (early October) can be distorted. Veterans enrolled in VA health care are mostly older and male, so values may not reflect transmission in the wider community.
info.statement: In {location}, VHA reported an average of {value} new COVID-19 cases per 100,000 enrolled veterans per day.

info.short_name: COVID-19 Vaccine Doses, Season to Date (VHA)
info.long_name: Cumulative COVID-19 vaccine doses given to VA patients since the start of the respiratory season
info.short_description: Cumulative COVID-19 vaccine doses administered by the Veterans Health Administration since the start of the respiratory season.
info.long_description: Cumulative number of COVID-19 vaccine doses administered to patients of the Veterans Health Administration since the start of the respiratory season, from the VHA Seasonal Disease Review via the CMU Delphi Epidata API. Delphi publishes this series daily; PopHIVE keeps the value reported for each week-ending Saturday. VHA intends these counts to reset each October 1. In 2026 they did not reset; instead, from the week ending 2026-09-26 the counts stopped increasing and repeat the end-of-season total (changing by only a few doses), so values from October 2026 onward do not reflect new vaccinations. VHA reports state counts under 11 as 5; those values are marked in the matching _suppressed_flag column. On dates when VHA's file was broken (most states reporting exactly 5), the value is set to missing. The national value is the sum of states. Veterans enrolled in VA health care are mostly older and male, so values may not reflect vaccination in the wider community.
info.statement: In {location}, VHA had given {value} COVID-19 vaccine doses.

info.short_name: COVID-19 Vaccine Doses (VHA), suppression flag
info.long_name: Flag for state COVID-19 vaccine dose counts censored by VHA (season to date)
info.short_description: 1 if VHA censored the state count (under 11, reported as 5), 0 otherwise.
info.long_description: Equals 1 when the state value of delphi_vha_covid_vaccines_season_cumulative is exactly 5, the placeholder VHA uses for counts under 11; the matching per-100,000 rate is then also based on that placeholder. 0 for uncensored state values. NA for the nation (national totals sum state values, including placeholders) and when the count is missing.

This is doses per 100,000, not the percent of veterans vaccinated: a veteran can receive more than one dose, and some state values exceed 100,000 (for example, Washington DC); Delphi does not document the reason. Delphi publishes this series daily; PopHIVE keeps the value reported for each week-ending Saturday. VHA intends these counts to reset each October 1. In 2026 they did not reset; instead, from the week ending 2026-09-26 the counts stopped increasing and repeat the end-of-season total (changing by only a few doses), so values from October 2026 onward do not reflect new vaccinations. Veterans enrolled in VA health care are mostly older and male, so values may not reflect vaccination in the wider community.

delphi_vha_flu_cases_cumulative.long_name: Cumulative lab-confirmed influenza cases among VA patients since the start of the respiratory season
delphi_vha_flu_cases_cumulative.short_description: Season-to-date count of lab-confirmed influenza cases reported by the Veterans Health Administration.
delphi_vha_flu_cases_cumulative.long_description: Cumulative number of laboratory-confirmed influenza cases among patients of the Veterans Health Administration since the start of the respiratory season (seasons run October 1 to September 30), from the VHA Seasonal Disease Review via the CMU Delphi Epidata API. Delphi publishes this series daily; PopHIVE keeps the value reported for each week-ending Saturday. The count resets at the start of each season; in 2026 the reset was delayed past October 1, so early-October values may still include the previous season. Cumulative counts can fall when VHA revises earlier reports. VHA censors counts under 11 upstream and reports them as 5, so some values may include this placeholder; it cannot be reliably identified in case counts (state values of 1-10 other than 5 also occur), so case counts are not flagged. National totals are withheld by Delphi on any day a state is missing, so the national series is often unavailable. Veterans enrolled in VA health care are mostly older and male, so values may not reflect transmission in the wider community.
delphi_vha_flu_cases_cumulative.statement: In {location}, VHA reported {value} lab-confirmed influenza cases so far this season.

delphi_vha_flu_cases_per_100k_7dav.long_name: New lab-confirmed influenza cases per 100,000 enrolled veterans, 7-day trailing average
delphi_vha_flu_cases_per_100k_7dav.short_description: Average daily new influenza cases per 100,000 enrolled veterans over the week.
delphi_vha_flu_cases_per_100k_7dav.long_description: Average daily number of newly reported laboratory-confirmed influenza cases per 100,000 veterans enrolled in VA health care, over the 7 days ending on the week-ending Saturday (that is, the Sunday-Saturday MMWR week), computed by the CMU Delphi Group from day-to-day changes in VHA's cumulative counts. Enrollee counts from the VHA Enrollees by County dataset are the denominator; state values are native, and the national value is an enrollee-weighted average of states. Delphi publishes this series daily; PopHIVE keeps the value reported for each week-ending Saturday. Because new cases are derived from changes in a cumulative count, downward revisions can produce negative values; these are set to missing. Rates around the season reset (early October) can be distorted. Veterans enrolled in VA health care are mostly older and male, so values may not reflect transmission in the wider community.

Delphi publishes this series daily; PopHIVE keeps the value reported for each week-ending Saturday. VHA intends these counts to reset each October 1. In 2026 they did not reset; instead, from the week ending 2026-09-26 the counts stopped increasing and repeat the end-of-season total (changing by only a few doses), so values from October 2026 onward do not reflect new vaccinations. VHA reports state counts under 11 as 5; those values are marked in the matching _suppressed_flag column. On dates when VHA's file was broken (most states reporting exactly 5), the value is set to missing. The national value is the sum of states. Veterans enrolled in VA health care are mostly older and male, so values may not reflect vaccination in the wider community.

delphi_vha_covid_vaccines_season_cumulat.long_description: Equals 1 when the state value of delphi_vha_covid_vaccines_season_cumulative is exactly 5, the placeholder VHA uses for counts under 11; the matching per-100,000 rate is then also based on that placeholder. 0 for uncensored state values. NA for the nation (national totals sum state values, including placeholders) and when the count is missing.

delphi_vha_cases.name: CMU Delphi Epidata - VHA Respiratory Cases and Vaccinations
delphi_vha_cases.organization: Carnegie Mellon University Delphi Research Group; U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs
delphi_vha_cases.description: Respiratory virus cases and vaccinations among patients of the Veterans Health Administration (VHA), the largest integrated health care system in the U.S., from the VHA Seasonal Disease Review on the VA Access to Care portal, accessed through the CMU Delphi Epidata API (v5) sources vha_respiratory_cases and vha_respiratory_vaccinations. Cases are laboratory-confirmed COVID-19, influenza and RSV cases, reported as season-to-date cumulative counts and as 7-day average new cases per 100,000 enrolled veterans. Vaccinations are cumulative COVID-19, influenza and RSV vaccine doses (season to date, plus lifetime RSV doses), as counts and per 100,000 enrolled veterans. Rates use enrollee counts from the VHA Enrollees by County dataset and come with 90% Wilson confidence intervals. Delphi publishes daily values from May 27, 2026; PopHIVE keeps the value for each week-ending Saturday, so 7-day averages correspond to Sunday-Saturday MMWR weeks. Data are available for states, DC and Puerto Rico and for the nation; national values are sums or enrollee-weighted averages of states, and national cumulative case totals are withheld whenever any state is missing. Important caveats: enrolled veterans are mostly older and male, so values may not reflect community transmission; case counts reflect testing and reporting, not symptom onset; cumulative counts can fall when VHA revises reports, which can make 7-day case rates negative (these are set to missing); VHA reports counts under 11 as 5; the season reset of cumulative counts on October 1 was delayed for cases, and vaccination counts did not reset but froze at their end-of-season totals from late September 2026; and the VHA portal keeps only about 30 days of files, which limits backfill of missing days.
delphi_vha_cases.restrictions: Public domain. Delphi lists this source as a public-domain U.S. Government work (17 U.S.C. 105).
